oe_ind2_dec_adopt_eparch_monopoly = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			current_year >= 1450
		}
		NOT = { has_employment_system = employment_system:oe_emp_eparch_royal_monopoly }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_ind2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 50
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_ind2_dec_adopt_eparch_monopoly.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -50
			set_country_employment_system = employment_system:oe_emp_eparch_royal_monopoly
		}
	}
}

oe_ind2_dec_adopt_wartime_ordnance = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		NOT = { has_employment_system = employment_system:oe_emp_wartime_ordnance_priority }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_ind2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 50
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_ind2_dec_adopt_wartime_ordnance.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -50
			set_country_employment_system = employment_system:oe_emp_wartime_ordnance_priority
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind2_ev3_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ind2_ev3_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind2.3
			}
		}
	}
}
